mentions.name: Clanker Cloud
mentions.description: This project automates infrastructure and systems engineering through devops agents. It began as a CLI project motivated by frustration with AWS and Terraform, targets pain points of devops/SRE work, and is planned for a public beta release next month.
mentions.problem: The pain points of working in devops and SRE, with the author sick of AWS and Terraform.
mentions.audience: Anyone working in devops, SRE, and systems engineering.
mentions.source_excerpt: Automating infra and systems engineering through devops agents. Basically solving all the pain points for anyone working in devops, sre, etc.
